# er605_vlan_port (Resource)

Link type and PVID of one switch port (port 1 = WAN, 2-3 = WAN/LAN, 4-5 = LAN on the ER605). Destroy only stops managing the port. Changing a port you are connected through can cut your session.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `port` (String) port number
- `pvid` (String) native VLAN id
- `type` (String) access, trunk or general

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `vlans` (List of String)
